basic.name: Flying Kick
basic.description: Kick through target enemy, dealing 130~~0.04~~ damage.

basic.name: Keg Smash
basic.description:
Deal 50~~0.04~~ damage and soak enemies in Brew for 3 seconds, Slowing them by 10%. After 1.25 seconds, the Slow is increased to 40%.

After being used, this Ability becomes Breath of Fire.

Breath of Fire
Deal damage and Ignite Brew-soaked enemies.

basic.name: Stagger
basic.description: Damage taken over the next 3 seconds is prevented.  Once this effect ends, Chen receives 75% of the damage taken over 5 seconds. This damage cannot be modified.

basic.name: Breath of Fire
basic.description:
Breathe a cone of flames, dealing 40~~0.04~~ damage. Enemies that are soaked in Brew are Ignited, dealing 342~~0.04~~ additional damage over 6 seconds and adding 1.5 seconds to the duration of the Slow from Keg Smash. 

After being used or after 6 seconds, this ability becomes Keg Smash.

Keg Smash
Damage and Slow enemies.

basic.name: Storm
basic.description:
The spirits gain a Shield for 400~~0.04~~ over 3 seconds.

If this is the final Ability cast, the shield amount is increased to 750~~0.04~~ with no limited duration, and the duration of Storm, Earth, Fire is increased by 5 seconds.

basic.name: Earth
basic.description:
Fire and Earth leap to the target location, dealing 32~~0.04~~ damage and Slowing enemies in a large area by 70% for 1.5 seconds.

If this is the final Ability cast, increase the damage dealt by 300% and instead of Slowing, the leap Roots enemy Heroes hit for 1.75 seconds.

basic.name: Fire
basic.description:
Increase the Attack Speed and Basic Attack damage of the spirits by 50% for 5 seconds.

If this is the final Ability cast, the Attack Speed and damage bonus is increased to 75% and the spirits gain 50% Movement Speed for its duration.

heroic.name: Storm, Earth, Fire
heroic.description:
After 1 second, Chen splits into three elemental spirits for 12 seconds, each with 70% of Chen's maximum Health and a unique Ability.  The last spirit Ability that is cast is empowered. If all three spirits are killed, Chen will die as well.

Storm can grant the spirits a Shield. 
Earth can leap to an area and Slow enemies. 
Fire can grant the spirits Attack Speed, damage.

heroic.name: Wandering Keg
heroic.description: Roll around inside an Unstoppable barrel with 70% increased Movement Speed and 25 Armor, dealing 59~~0.04~~ damage to enemies in the way and knocking them back. Lasts for 5 seconds.

trait.name: Fortifying Brew
trait.description: Chen drinks from his keg, gaining 50 Brew and 190~~0.04~~ temporary Shields per second, up to a maximum of 570~~0.04~~ while drinking. Shields persist for 4 seconds after he stops drinking.

activable.name: Hearthstone
activable.description: After Channeling for 6 seconds, teleport back to the Hall of Storms, instantly restoring 1125 Health and 150 Brew.

activable.name: Elusive Brawler
activable.description: Activate to gain 20% Movement Speed and Evade enemy Basic Attacks for 2 seconds. Chen's Basic Attacks reduce this cooldown by 2 seconds.

activable.name: Hearthstone
activable.description: After Channeling for 6 seconds, teleport back to the Hall of Storms, instantly restoring 1125 Health.

level1.name: Accumulating Flame
level1.description:
Reward: Damage enemy Heroes with Breath of Fire to permanently increase periodic damage by 0.25. Kills grant 2.

Reward: After gaining 25 damage, increase the range of Keg Smash.

Mythic Reward: Upon gaining 80 damage, Breath of Fire reduces enemy Armor by 20 and its duration is increased by 0.75 seconds each time Chen attacks the Hero.

level1.name: Freshest Ingredients
level1.description:
Increase the healing duration of Regeneration Globes by 150%.

Quest: Gather 15 Regeneration Globes.

Reward: Reduce Fortifying Brew's cooldown by 2 seconds, and 50% of its Shield persists indefinitely after drinking.

level1.name: Stormstout Secret Recipe
level1.description: Chen heals for 3.5% of his maximum Health when his Basic Abilities hit an enemy Hero.

level4.name: Deadly Strike
level4.description: Flying Kick no longer costs Brew. Additionally, its damage is increased by 125% while Chen has Shields from Fortifying Brew.

level4.name: Eye of the Tiger
level4.description: Basic Attacks against Brew-soaked enemy Heroes deal 50% more damage and heal Chen for 60% of the damage done.

level4.name: Withering Flames
level4.description: Igniting an enemy Hero reduces their Spell Power by 60% for 4 seconds.

level7.name: Gift of the Ox
level7.description: Increase the duration of Stagger's damage prevention by 2 seconds, and reduce the amount of damage taken over time to 50% of damage taken.

level7.name: Brewmaster's Balance
level7.description: While at or below 50 Brew, gain 20% Movement Speed. While at or above 50 Brew, regenerate an additional 18~~0.04~~ Health per second.

level7.name: Elusive Brawler
level7.description: Activate to gain 20% Movement Speed and Evade enemy Basic Attacks for 2 seconds. Chen's Basic Attacks reduce this cooldown by 2 seconds.

level10.name: Wandering Keg
level10.description: Roll around inside an Unstoppable barrel with 70% increased Movement Speed and 25 Armor, dealing 59~~0.04~~ damage to enemies in the way and knocking them back. Lasts for 5 seconds.

level13.name: Pressure Point
level13.description: Flying Kick Slows the target enemy by 40% for 1.5 seconds, or by 80% if Chen has Shields from Fortifying Brew.

level13.name: A Touch of Honey
level13.description: Increase the Slows from Keg Smash by 20% and its duration by 0.5 seconds.

level13.name: Ring of Fire
level13.description: After Igniting an enemy, become bathed in a fiery aura, dealing 60~~0.04~~ damage every second to nearby enemies for 6 seconds.

level13.name: Enough to Share
level13.description: Fortifying Brew instantly grants Chen a Shield that absorbs 190~~0.04~~ damage, and each second grants nearby allied Heroes a Shield that absorbs 140~~0.04~~ damage, up to 420~~0.04~~.

level16.name: Flying Leap
level16.description: Increase Flying Kick's range by 15% and reduce its cooldown by 0.5 seconds each time an enemy Hero takes damage from being Ignited.

level16.name: Celerity
level16.description: Basic Attacks against Stunned, Rooted, or Slowed enemy Heroes reduce the cooldown of Stagger by 2 seconds and grant Chen 30 Armor for 3 seconds.

level16.name: Combo Strikes
level16.description: Every 3rd Basic Attack against the same target deals 75% bonus damage. While Chen has Shields from Fortifying Brew and for 2 seconds after, he gains 35% Attack Speed.

level20.name: Untapped Potential
level20.description: Increase Wandering Keg's Movement Speed bonus from 70% to 125%, and its Armor bonus to 75 for its duration and 5 seconds afterwards.

level20.name: Elemental Conduit
level20.description: Increase the spirits' Health to 100% of Chen's maximum Health and all of their Abilities are empowered.

level20.name: Purifying Brew
level20.description: Casting Fortifying Brew grants Chen Unstoppable for 1.5 seconds.

level20.name: Energizing Brew
level20.description: If Chen Channels Fortifying Brew for its full duration, then he gains 20% bonus Health and 20% bonus damage for 25 seconds.
